fields.title: Explain the normal-profile sync-queue change during isolated QA
fields.description: Normal library.json/settings.json hashes stayed unchanged, but sync-queue.json changed. Which process wrote it and whether isolation was breached are unresolved.
fields.notes: Owner smoke intake 2026-10-26. Proposed priority P1. Sources F17. Acceptance/evidence: docs/planning/roadmap-reviews/2026-10-26-smoke-triage.md. Stub; investigation/specification required. Release hold unchanged.
fields.deliverable: Attribute the writer using bounded evidence, classify intended versus unintended writes, and fix a proven isolation defect if found. Preserve the queue and user data; do not call this data loss or attribute it to the scratch app without proof.
